features: ⚠️ THIS VERSION ADDS THREE MIGRATIONS, one of which changes the structure: the link between a document and its category moves from a column to a table of its own, because categories are now more than one. Existing data is moved automatically.

A DOCUMENT CAN BE IN SEVERAL CATEGORIES — A request from the forum. The minutes of the meeting that approves the budget are found under «Verbali» and under «Bilanci», and appear in both lists, including the one residents browse in their area. In the list the column shows the first two labels and then a «+N», with the full list on hover.

⚠️ WHAT DOES NOT CHANGE — Documents uploaded on a supplier, a unit or a person stay WITHOUT a category, as before: those forms do not ask for one, because those documents live on their subject's record. For the archive a category is mandatory, at least one: an archive document with no category appears in no category view, and that is how documents get lost.

⚠️ RESIDENTS CAN CHOOSE CATEGORIES TOO — The form residents use to upload a document had no category field: it was taken silently from the folder they came from. The edit form did have one, so putting a document in two categories meant saving it and reopening it. The field is now on the upload form as well, with the category they came from already selected.

THE RESIDENT AREA'S PAGINATION WAS IN ENGLISH — «First», «Previous», «Next», «Last» under every list in their area: noticeboard, reports, documents, calendar. It now follows the program's language, including the labels screen readers announce.

SORTING BY CATEGORY HAS BEEN REMOVED — With several categories per document it has no answer. In its place the list gained two more useful things: a DATE column — the real date, not «three months ago» — and a STATUS filter, next to those for category and building.

YOU CAN NOW SEE WHO IS BEHIND THE INITIALS — The «Buildings» and «People» columns showed circles with initials and the name only on hover. They now open, as in the buildings list, and each row leads to the record.

⚠️ DELETING A CATEGORY: THE MESSAGE WAS FALSE — The confirmation warned it would delete «the category and all documents associated with it». That was never true: the program refuses to delete a category that holds documents and touches none of them. Document categories now behave like supplier ones: a column says how many documents use each, and trying to delete one in use opens a window saying which, with the link to go there.

⚠️ THE «FATTURE» CATEGORY NO LONGER BREAKS IF YOU RENAME IT — The program looked it up by name: renaming it meant every invoice attachment silently landed in the archive with no category. It is now recognised by an internal key that never changes, and the label stays yours.

DOCUMENT CATEGORIES NO LONGER COME BACK FROM THE DEAD — They were written by a seeder that put them back at every maintenance run: a category deleted on purpose could reappear on its own. The five initial ones are now written by a migration, which runs once.
